pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches on the flank with sharp edge-to-corridor gradients; patches exhibit a size-gradient reduction from the mid-flank toward the lower neck and ventral boundary.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a mesh-like topology; junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate with consistent pixel thickness across the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal neck contour.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark-colored avian-shaped clusters (symbiotic birds) localized on the mid-neck and along the dorsal ridge line.
